title: Symmetry-first projectable completion requirement/class theorem
question: What exact structural conditions can protect the rank-one scalar kinetic architecture in a projectable ADM completion without choosing coefficients from the failed soft-s observable, and are those conditions sufficient by themselves to identify one full RTK action?

frozen_setup.quadratic_algebraic_sector: 1/2 q^T M q + s^T q J, with symmetric M
frozen_setup.symmetry_test: local field-space redundancy delta q = epsilon(x,t) n

theorem_checks: local null-direction gauge invariance of the algebraic quadratic sector requires M*n=0
local null-direction gauge invariance of a linear source coupling requires s.n=0
for symmetric 2x2 M with M*n=0, M is rank <=1 and proportional to u*u^T
s.n=0 forces s proportional to u
after quotienting the null direction, the quadratic scalar response contains at most one finite pole

decision_rule.SYMMETRY_PROTECTED_CLASS_PASS_SCOPED: If all exact structural identities hold. This establishes a nonempty symmetry-protected rank-one class, not a unique full action.
decision_rule.THEOREM_FAIL_SCOPED: If any frozen exact identity fails.
decision_rule.FULL_ACTION_IDENTIFIED: Forbidden classification in this gate; the theorem must not infer a unique nonlinear completion from quadratic symmetry conditions alone.

scope: Exact kinematic/algebraic class theorem only. A future candidate must separately specify a nonlinear symmetry realization, ADM/clock field map, gravitational and potential operators, background functions, matter coupling, and full constraint algebra before s6fT can be rerun.
